answer_1.quote: Traditional TOD systems ... include natural language generation. AutoTOD directly outputs the natural language responses rather than the delexicalized utterances.
answer_1.outputs: system response utterances in the dialogue

answer_2.quote: We also use some language diversity metrics ... The metrics include ... BLEU ... Inform, Success, Book, Combine ... SE, CE, MSTTR, MTLD, HDD.

answer_3.quote: The dialogue evaluator employs a pretrained large language model (GPT-3.5) to extract essential information from the generated dialogues.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation ... ask 5 graduate students to rate from 4 aspects: language fluency (Fluency), dialogue coherence (Coherence), information accuracy in responses (Informativeness), and overall satisfaction (Satisfaction).
answer_4.guideline: Rate each dialogue on fluency, coherence, informativeness, and overall satisfaction.
